svg.title: NajdiLab Core — verified source-only architecture
svg.desc: Local browser and credentialed ingestion enter loopback request checks. Atomic review and read-only dataset diagnostics use SQLite and private version files. Explicit downloads are restricted to verified JSONL. Coherent backup and separate restore are offline. Models are external; no extension interface is packaged.
svg.text: NajdiLab Core
Local conversation review and dataset preparation · no model execution
CANDIDATE-LOCAL APPLICATION AND STORAGE
Local browser
English controls · Arabic content · explicit saved decisions
Authorized native ingestion
Bearer / HMAC · completed turns · no live integration discovery
Loopback HTTP and request boundary
Host / Origin / Fetch Metadata · browser CSRF · native credential checks
JSON framing and 2 MiB limit · safe DOM/CSP · candidate server + http_security
Contextual review
core_reviews + service + read-only core_views
BEGIN IMMEDIATE · required revision · preserve flags / notes
Immutable originals · separate corrections · explicit eligibility
Dataset preparation and inspection
core_datasets + snapshot + generic quality helpers
Context privacy · split / dedup / holdout / strict masks
Registered manifest + exact filenames, counts and SHA256
SQLite: local state
Conversations / original messages / review overlays
Eligibility and privacy decisions · registered version metadata
Existing schema 001–004 only · no proposed SQL
Filesystem: local version evidence
JSONL files + manifest + hashes · never a public upload
Private full_archive.json retains recovery evidence
Verified snapshots feed diagnostics and selected downloads
One server per storage root
OS lock + serialized mutations
Private backup and separate restore
Local CLI · SQLite snapshot + its registered version bytes
ZIP / database / manifest integrity · exclusive new destination
Full archives remain private; no model/runtime recovery
Explicit artifact access
HTTP attachment · selected manifest-authorized JSONL only
No archive, DB, credentials, model or arbitrary path access
Local file retrieval is not permission to redistribute
Boundary: local dataset preparation only · external model services · unknown removed routes return 404
